test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

None of the __witnessed could identify__ the suspect.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, "None of the witnessed could identify the suspect," the underlined part **"witnessed could identify"** is incorrect because "witnessed" is being used incorrectly.
 
• The correct noun form is **"witnesses".**
 
• **"Could identify"** is in the **correct tense** and mood, suggesting a possibility or ability in the past. It does not need to be changed.

Therefore, the **corrected sentence** is:* "None of the witnesses could identify the suspect."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2) "witness had identify"** is incorrect because it does not properly conjugate the verb "identify" in the past perfect tense, which would be "had identified". Furthermore, "witness" needs to be in the plural form "witnesses" to agree with "none".
 
• **Option 3) "witnessed could identified" **is incorrect because it misuses "witnessed" as a noun and incorrectly conjugates "could identify" as "could identified".
